descriptionHtml:
76 × 51cm. Memory foam over egg-crate. Four walls for a burrower.

Skelwith is a memory foam nest dog sofa bed, 76 × 51cm, bolstered on all four sides, with memory foam over an egg-crate layer and fleece on top.

There are dogs who stretch out and dogs who fold themselves into the smallest shape they can manage. The second kind sleep curled tight, spine pressed into something, nose tucked under a back leg. Put one on an open mattress and they spend half the evening hunting for an edge that is not there.

Four cushioned sides mean that whichever way they turn there is something to press into, and the memory foam takes the shape of a curled dog rather than a flat one.

What they get

  • Bolstered all the way round: Four cushioned sides rather than three and a gap.
  • Two layers of foam: Memory foam over an egg-crate support layer.
  • Fleece inside the walls: A soft sleeping surface where they curl up.
  • Textured linen-effect side panels: Sides that read as furniture rather than pet kit.

Best for: burrowers, small and medium dogs who sleep curled, and a bed that has to live in the front room.

Why it is worth the money

£165 for a 76 × 51cm bed needs explaining, so here it is. Two layers of foam rather than one. A surround that closes on all four sides. Panels that do not shout pet shop across your lounge. The foam core carries a 5-year no-flatten guarantee, and £165 spread across the 1825 nights that guarantee runs for is about 9p a night. Most beds look shabby inside two years.

And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

Be clear what 76 × 51cm means. That is the outside, and a four-sided bolster takes a good part of it. This is a bed for a dog who curls. One who sleeps flat out will hang over the wall.

Size and fit

SizeExternal (cm)Shape
One size76 × 51Bolstered on all four sides

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Measure them curled up too, because that is how a nest bed gets used. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Newlands drops its front for a dog who finds a wall hard going. Skelwith keeps all four at full height, because a burrower wants the wall.

Everyday care

Follow the sewn-in care label on the cover. Air-dry it fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

The questions we get asked most

Is it too small for a medium dog?

It is 76 × 51cm outside with the bolster taking part of that. If the numbers land close, send us the breed and weight before you order.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.
